sections.content: Use connectors such as primero, después, mientras, mediante, por eso and por último to explain stages and relationships within a process. A clear explanation states what happens and how or why it happens.

items.spanish: Primero se prepara el material y después se corta.
items.english: First the material is prepared and then it is cut.

items.spanish: Mediante este sistema, se reduce el consumo de energía.
items.english: By means of this system, energy consumption is reduced.

items.spanish: Después se revisa cada pieza para evitar errores.
items.english: Then each piece is checked to avoid errors.

items.spanish: Por último, se comprueba que todo funciona correctamente.
items.english: Lastly, it is checked that everything works correctly.

sections.content: Do not list actions without relationships. Explain the sequence and, where useful, the purpose or consequence.
